camel_example: aliyun dcdn GetDcdnKvStatus --region cn-hangzhou --Namespace ns1 --Key key1
description_en: Queries the status of a key-value (KV) pair by key
description_zh: 调用GetDcdnKvStatus按Key值查询KV状态信息
kebab_example: aliyun dcdn get-dcdn-kv-status --namespace ns1 --key key1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetDcdnKvStatus

parameters.help_en: The name of the key to query
parameters.name: key

Complete.description_en:
Indicates whether the key configuration has taken effect globally.

true: The configuration has taken effect globally.
false: The configuration has not taken effect globally
Complete.description_zh:
配置的Key是否已全网生效。
true：已全网生效。
false：未全网生效

Expire.description_en: The expiration time of the key, specified as an absolute timestamp. Example: 2023-09-11T15:39:44+08:00. This parameter is not returned if the key is stored permanently
Expire.description_zh: 配置的Key的超时时间（绝对时间戳，如2023-09-11T15:39:44+08:00），当永久存储时不返回
